text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, I stopped by a
sporting goods store at Meisho Doto's request.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for dragging you along...
I just... wear through shoes so fast...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Is falling over too much really the reason?
I try to be careful, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Doto...?
What's up, you pickin' out shoes too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sharp-eyed Umamusume who called out to me.
If I remember correctly, that's Air Shakur, who shares a dorm room with Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Shakur-san, are you
going shopping now too...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm leaving. Heard even shoe geeks
frequent this place so I checked it out,
but they don't even display the specs. Total waste of time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...See ya, Doto.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto continues to glance nervously
at Air Shakur as she walks away.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No... Shakur-san, didn't you say
you couldn't choose your shoes...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering if there was anything I could do to help...
Since I'm always causing trouble for you, Shakur-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm always forgetting things...
So Shakur-san often can't bear to watch and speaks up to help me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I want to thank him properly, but...
He always tells me that sort of thing is 'noisy'..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still... I was just thinking that maybe
I could be of some help with the shopping, you see...
choice_data_list: Should we try calling out to them again?
Want to try calling out to them again?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. I'll give that a try~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Shakur-san, p-please wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Dotou? If you panic, you're gonna trip again.
Need somethin'?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~. Um, I was hoping
to help you with your shopping, Shakur-san~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I wear out my shoes really quickly, so I've worn all kinds of pairs up until now...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I kept notes on which shoes wore out and how,
so I thought it might be of some help...
Though maybe I'm just getting ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Notes on the durability
of all the shoes tested so far? How intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So, what're you schemin'?
This ain't the kinda info you hand over for free, is it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it...
I just wanted to show my appreciation for everything you do for me, you see...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah? What're you on about? I ain't looking after anyone.
More importantly, if we're making a deal, hurry up and tell me what you want.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"E-Even if you say that~.
Wh-Wh-What should we do, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Why don't you ask them to practice with you instead?
Tell me what you recommend over there too!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk. Your Trainer's pretty sharp, huh?
Making sure not to show any of their own data.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: R-R-Right, I-I-I mean, practicing with someone like me is just a burden, right? I'm so, so sorryyy~!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"No, I don't mind. In exchange, once we get back to the dorms,
you're going to sit down and review the data with me, got it?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, if that's all it is, I don't mind at all.
...Wait, are you really sure it's okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard later that the verification work went late into the night.
Even so, Meisho Doto seemed genuinely happy
to have been of help.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Then it's a tie, huh... Just go with the brand
lined up near the entrance. The red one, or the purple next to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That place lists accurate specs on their website.
The red ones are built tough. The purple ones have great grip
and make it harder to slip.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Considering your running style and knee flexibility,
that has to be the optimal solution, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaaaa, thank you so much!
U-Um, I'll buy both of them!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Both of ya... don't you think you're trustin' other people a bit too much?
Well, fine. Once you put 'em on, let me take actual measurements of that, too.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Understoood~! I'll go buy them~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's advice must have made
Meisho Doto so happy, as she headed off
to the shop in high spirits.
